about: Technology leader with 22 years of experience building product engineering organisations. Focused on sustainable growth, engineering excellence and customer outcomes.

Finance leader responsible for controllership, financial planning, payroll governance and commercial operations.
Payroll specialist managing monthly payroll inputs, statutory documentation and employee payroll queries.
Sales leader for enterprise accounts in India. Builds consultative selling teams and long-term customer relationships.
Marketing leader across brand, demand generation and product marketing. Data-led approach to growth storytelling.
